text: I see no marriages where the conjugal compatibility sooner fails than those that we contract upon the account of beauty and amorous desires; there should be more solid and constant foundation, and they should proceed with greater circumspection; this furious ardour is worth nothing.
author: Michel de Montaigne
locator: Book III, Chapter V, Upon Some Verses of Virgil
translation: Charles Cotton, ed. W. C. Hazlitt, 1877
